annotations.title: Get one book from my library

description: Which of up to 25 books the linked reader already has, with shelf, rating, progress and their review for each. Takes titles ("Title by Author" resolves best) or workIds. Suits "have I read X", "what did I write about X", "which of these have I read" and checking suggestions before recommending them. Titles not in the catalog come back under unmatched. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

books.description: Work ids, siftivo.com slugs, or titles, optionally "Title by Author"
